indicator_name: CPI by group, COICOP division, item and region, January–month over January–month of previous year = 100
description: ИПЦ по группам, разделам КООЛИЦ, товарам и услугам и по регионам, январь–месяц к январю–месяцу прошлого года
unit: index, same period (January to month) of previous year = 100
methodology: As CPI_DETAIL_MOM: the average price level since January against the same months a year earlier (the annual average inflation in December).
